summary.motive: Use simple inside-zone action to freeze the second level while the slot runs a leverage-based vertical shot for a touchdown.
summary.whyItWorks: One word triggers the whole play: the run action buys the linebackers, the choice stem punishes whichever way the nickel leans, and both corners are cleared out.
summary.failureMode: The nickel plays pure man from the snap instead of fitting run, staying attached to the slot's hip throughout the climb.

beats.title: 1. The Run Picture Sells
beats.text: Five linemen fire inside-zone steps and the quarterback rides the give. Both linebackers trigger downhill and the nickel steps toward the box.

beats.title: 2. The Nickel Loses His Feet
beats.text: The slot takes his CHOICE release straight upfield off outside leverage. The nickel, mid-run-fit, must stop his feet and turn — losing two critical yards.

beats.title: 3. The Safety Picks a Seam
beats.text: With both corners pinned and the TE stretching the middle, the free safety must choose between the boundary seam and the field-side window. He picks wrong.

beats.title: 4. The Single-Word Shot Pays
beats.text: The whole call was one word — the slot's choice route ran itself off leverage. The quarterback delivers over the top of the still-triggering defense.

relations.tell: The slot releases instantly vertical with no stem variation — a true option route adjusts mid-route; this one never breaks.
